MeetingCancellationV10/Cancellation1Guid: It is recommended that a meeting is canceled with the use of MeetingReference/MeetingIdentification, MeetingReference/Type and Security and Reason only. It is recommended that optional elements are not used.
MeetingInstructionCancellationRequestV10: It is recommended that the request to cancel a meeting instruction be done with the use of MeetingInstructionIdentification only and that the optional elements are avoided, unless otherwise specified by market practice rules and or legislation. If any optional elements are included, they must be identical to the information in the meeting instruction message being canceled.
